items.name: use-local-storage
items.title: useLocalStorage
items.description: SSR-safe localStorage hook with typed values, cross-tab sync via the storage event, and a state-style setter (value or updater). Returns [value, setValue, remove].

items.name: use-media-query
items.title: useMediaQuery + useBreakpoint
items.description: Reactive media-query hook plus a named-breakpoint helper (isMobile / isTablet / isDesktop) tuned to Tailwind v4 defaults. SSR-safe.

items.name: use-clipboard
items.title: useClipboard
items.description: Copy hook with a 'copied' flag that auto-resets after a configurable timeout. Falls back to document.execCommand for older browsers without the Clipboard API.

items.name: use-debounce
items.title: useDebounce + useDebouncedCallback
items.description: Value-debouncing hook and a callback-debouncing companion (with a cancel() method). Latest fn / args win. Universal for search inputs, autosave, expensive computations.

items.name: use-throttle
items.title: useThrottle + useThrottledCallback
items.description: Value-throttling and callback-throttling hooks for scroll/mouse-rate signals where every change isn't worth a render or invocation.

items.name: use-event-listener
items.title: useEventListener
items.description: Typed event listener hook with auto-cleanup. Overloads for window / document / element-ref targets. Captures the latest handler in a ref so consumers never need to memoise.

items.name: use-intersection-observer
items.title: useIntersectionObserver
items.description: Generic visibility hook returning { ref, entry, isIntersecting }. Optional freezeOnceVisible for one-shot reveals (lazy-load, scroll-triggered animations, view tracking).

items.name: use-previous
items.title: usePrevious
items.description: Returns the previous render's value. Tiny but constantly needed (compare props, animate on change, log transitions).

items.name: use-keyboard-shortcuts
items.title: useKeyboardShortcuts + formatShortcut
items.description: Register keyboard shortcuts with a typed API. Auto-cleans on unmount. Supports `mod` (Cmd/Ctrl), modifier combos, ignores input/textarea/contenteditable by default. Includes `formatShortcut` for pretty-printing in help dialogs.
